scope: Smarter Justice and its independent legal portals only
purpose: Turn portfolio truth into a concise, deterministic, owner-controlled legal-network execution queue without automating portal changes.

rules.title: Resolve a legacy professional portal assignment without unsafe inference

boundaries: No automatic deployment or portal mutation.
A recommendation does not equal an owner decision.
Owner disposition resurfaces when underlying evidence changes.
Professional payment never establishes verification, practice evidence, portal placement, organic rank, inquiry eligibility, or appointment eligibility.
Professional-network portal contracts are export-only and do not mutate dedicated portals.
Canonical mapping is allowed only for unambiguous aliases; unresolved legacy assignments remain outside portal exports.
